description: List Qonto bank accounts and completed transactions that are missing an invoice or receipt, then attach a PDF, JPEG, or PNG from the agent workspace.
limitations: Read-only except uploading an attachment to a transaction. No transfers, no deletes, no edits. Upload reads a file from the agent's home. Production API only.
setup_hint: Connect with the organization's Qonto login and secret key from Integrations → API key.

tools.name: list_bank_accounts
tools.description: List Qonto bank accounts for the connected organization. Use this to choose which account_id to scan for missing invoices. Returns id, name, iban, currency, and status.

tools.name: list_missing_invoices
tools.description: Find completed Qonto transactions that still need an invoice or receipt: empty attachment_ids, attachment_required true, and attachment_lost false. Optional bank_account_id (otherwise every active account), settled_from/settled_to (ISO dates, default last 90 days), side (debit, credit, or both; default debit), and min_amount in euros.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Fetch one Qonto transaction by id, including current attachment_ids. Confirm a transaction before uploading an invoice and after the upload lands.

tools.name: upload_invoice
tools.description: Attach a PDF, JPEG, or PNG from the agent workspace as the invoice for a Qonto transaction. file_path is in the agent's home. Refuses if the transaction already has attachments unless force is true. Qonto processes the file in the background; this waits until attachment_ids is populated or 60 seconds elapse.
